name: Tainted Treasure
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle/warpriest 4, druid/hunter 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (lead coin), DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target a dragon’s hoard
Duration see text
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Weaving poisonous magic into a dragon’s hoard, you set a deadly trap. Once a dragon touches the affected hoard, the trap springs, poisoning the dragon. This poison deals 1d4 Constitution damage per round for 7 rounds. Poisoned creatures can make a Fortitude save each round to halve this Con damage. Two saves are required to end the affliction. The magic lasts for 1 day per level.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
